Format: PRAZ-S-NNN
Date the PSQI was administered
Study visit number at which PSQI was collected
Component 1: subjective overall sleep quality (0=very good; 3=very bad)
Component 2: time to fall asleep (0=<15 min; 3=>60 min)
Component 3: hours of actual sleep (0=>7 hrs; 3=<5 hrs)
Component 4: time in bed vs time asleep (0=>85%; 3=<65%)
Component 5: frequency of sleep-disturbing events (0=not during past month; 3=3+ times/week)
Component 6: frequency of sleep medication use (0=not during past month; 3=3+ times/week)
Component 7: daytime sleepiness and motivation impairment (0=no problem; 3=very big problem)
Sum of the seven component scores; higher scores indicate worse sleep quality
